test.name: SpyBrowser.Tests.FillContextCloseAcceptanceTests.Compatible_fill_waiting_on_disabled_field_fails_when_context_closes_and_settles_original_task
test.scenario: Playwright-compatible wrapped locator Fill waits on a disabled input with native action Timeout=0; the browser context is explicitly closed while Fill is pending.
assertions: Fill start synchronization completes and original returned Fill task is still pending before context close.
Before close, input value remains untouched and input event count is zero.
Context close completes under a separate 10-second safety deadline.
Awaiting the Fill task under a separate 10-second safety deadline yields TaskCanceledException from the pending native Playwright locator operation.
Failure is not a timeout, Fill task is settled, and context reports closed.
test.scopeNote: No post-close DOM read is possible; no effect is established by pre-close value/event observations, while task settlement proves no orphan Fill operation remains.

firstAttempt.reason: Initial assertion expected PlaywrightException; actual context-close cancellation was TaskCanceledException. Assertion was aligned to observed native pending-command cancellation; focused rerun passed.

sourceAndPackage.compatibleFillDispatch: Explicit LocatorFillOptions follows the native proxy path; HumanizingDispatchProxy<T>.InvokeCore calls targetMethod.Invoke(_target, nativeArguments). The test does not use the RpaRunner cancellation wrapper.

consumerCheckAssessment.route: Actual RpaRunner RunAsync cancellation during FillWhenReadyAsync/FillWithRuntimeAsync; cancels caller token and awaits runner before checking context closed.
consumerCheckAssessment.providedConsumerLanes: Three final ef2d consumer lanes reported 14/14 passed; not rerun for this focused test and not a substitute for directly awaiting Fill.
